remarks: This 3 bedroom all-brick ranch is located within the Amherst School District. Arrive to the welcoming front porch, a concrete driveway, and a landscaped front pond. Inside, hardwood floors run through the main level. The large living room and formal dining room provide an open feel, accented by classic cove molding and a bright bay windows. The nice-sized kitchen comes equipped with a dishwasher, and all other appliances stay with the home. Down the hallway, which includes two linen closets for plenty of storage, you will find three comfortable bedrooms. The main bedroom the seller enclosed the closet to hang a TV, the closet doors are currently being stored in the basement,  recessed lighting and its own private attached octagon sunroom. It features a cozy gas fireplace and French doors that lead directly out to a brick patio. The fully fenced yard offers a private retreat, complete with a small backyard pond and a two-car detached garage. The massive partially finished basement significantly expands your square footage. It features a huge 38' x 13' recreation room complete with a built-in wet bar—perfect for an entertainment hub. The basement also includes secure glass block windows and a non-functional half bath. Equipped with central air for year-round comfort, this home is being sold as-is and does need some TLC but offers the perfect canvas to bring your favorite colors and personal style to life.
